bug_semantics: A frontend client could supply a local Spark resource path such as /allowed/root/../../etc/passwd. Kyuubi parsed the value as a URI but tested the raw uri.getPath string with startsWith against kyuubi.session.local.dir.allow.list. The raw string retained '..', so it began with an allowed prefix and passed validation; later filesystem/Spark path resolution collapsed the traversal and accessed a file outside the allowed directory.
flaw_origin: PR #2991 member 4f2faa6a22541ef850f5b049149e08ab6fd4c49b first introduced the allow-list enforcement and the flawed raw-prefix predicate localDirAllowList.exists(uri.getPath.startsWith(_)) in KyuubiSessionManager.checkSessionAccessPathURI. Later PR member 6eca2f8beaa46242cac1d0b67632b1a90c4d08f0 only moved the predicate into KyuubiApplicationManager, and squash commit b585fb4257995d5dd8905c0a25e62a13a1264b77 landed it; neither the move nor the squash is the smallest BIC.
ai_marker: absent — the BIC commit object identifies author Fei Wang <fwang12@ebay.com> and committer Fei Wang under the same human GitHub identity, has subject 'save', and has an empty body: no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI trailer is present.
evidence: The first-party Apache advisory reference and GHSA identify unauthorized local-directory access caused by missing path normalization, affecting Apache Kyuubi 1.6.0 through 1.10.2 and fixed in 1.10.3; the advisory attack surface is any client able to reach Kyuubi frontend protocols.

git log --all -S'uri.getPath.startsWith' over KyuubiApplicationManager.scala and KyuubiSessionManager.scala returned the landing squash b585fb4257995d5dd8905c0a25e62a13a1264b77 and normalization fixes 6d844ea02ef810543dfaf169ac7a49a54c0a846b/da728ba212f7c413ccf0894d23eebec96253417e. git log -L 149,171:kyuubi-server/src/main/scala/org/apache/kyuubi/engine/KyuubiApplicationManager.scala traced the surviving function back through b585fb4257995d5dd8905c0a25e62a13a1264b77.

The public PR #2991 patch exposes all ten pre-squash commits. Patch 01/10, 4f2faa6a22541ef850f5b049149e08ab6fd4c49b, adds SESSION_LOCAL_DIR_ALLOW_LIST, wires client-controlled Spark path configurations into session opening, and adds localDirAllowList.exists(uri.getPath.startsWith(_)); patch 07/10, 6eca2f8beaa46242cac1d0b67632b1a90c4d08f0, relocates the same predicate, proving that the later squash aggregate is not the smallest origin.

Direct parent-tree verification: the BIC commit page records parent 163e0f8232959b3fd365785f5a5312d2457bd290, and the parent version of kyuubi-server/src/main/scala/org/apache/kyuubi/session/KyuubiSessionManager.scala has neither localDirAllowList nor checkSessionAccessPathURI nor any raw-prefix allow-list predicate. The BIC diff adds all three, so the vulnerable mechanism is absent at the immediate parent.

Version boundary: git tag --contains b585fb4257995d5dd8905c0a25e62a13a1264b77 --list 'v1.6.0*' includes v1.6.0-incubating (peeled tag commit 83118a514612a85b2df35a9aa3d42d75fd27aa36), matching the first affected release. The decomposed BIC is represented in release history by that squash.

Fix and patched boundary: da728ba212f7c413ccf0894d23eebec96253417e changes the predicate to Paths.get(uri.getPath).normalize.startsWith(_) and adds a regression case for /apache/kyuubi/../a.jar. git merge-base --is-ancestor reports da728... absent from v1.10.2 (peeled 494c42517c8e3c3f1eda533493e8193ed0ed7850) and present in v1.10.3 (peeled 3b8105221a482f6f5665207d752640b41961ceac); git tag --contains da728... lists v1.10.3. It is a direct cherry-pick of original master fix 6d844ea02ef810543dfaf169ac7a49a54c0a846b.

BIC-only AI inspection used the 4f2faa6a22541ef850f5b049149e08ab6fd4c49b commit object, not PR prose or later commits. Its embedded commit metadata shows human author/committer Fei Wang, subject 'save', and an empty body; the patch header gives author Fei Wang <fwang12@ebay.com>. There is no AI marker or attribution trailer.
reasoning: The vulnerability begins when PR #2991 creates a server-side allow list for client-selected local Spark resource paths but compares an unnormalized URI path as a raw string. Because lexical prefix testing happens before downstream path resolution, an allowed-prefix path containing '..' crosses the intended directory boundary. Decomposing the landing squash is decisive: the first PR member, 4f2faa6a22541ef850f5b049149e08ab6fd4c49b, already contains the flawed comparison and the reachable session/application wiring; subsequent members add an absolute-path check, refactor, move, rename, or comment on that mechanism without first creating it. Its immediate parent tree lacks the entire allow-list check, satisfying parent absence. Squash b585fb4257995d5dd8905c0a25e62a13a1264b77 carries the member's code into v1.6.0-incubating. The 1.10 branch fix da728ba212f7c413ccf0894d23eebec96253417e normalizes the path before prefix comparison and is included in v1.10.3 but not v1.10.2, matching the advisory boundary. Finally, only the smallest BIC's commit object was used for attribution; it contains a human author/committer and no AI marker, so the closed verdict is NOT_AI.
